title: Data you can use and results you can verify
promise: Complete a verifiable project milestone and keep evidence that another person can inspect.
why: A working demo is only the start. The handoff requires evidence about data, permissions, failure recovery and usefulness in the actual task.

theory.title: Data inventory
theory.text: List each input field, its source, permission to use it and deletion rule. Use fictional identifiers during practice.
theory.example: A field / source / permission / retention / test value table, with no real personal data or secrets.

theory.title: Input and output contract
theory.text: Specify required fields, types, ranges and error output. Prepare valid input, missing required input and malformed input. Run all three.
theory.example: Three recorded outcomes; invalid inputs are isolated before any external write.

theory.title: Check provenance
theory.text: For five responses or transformations, record the source and verify that the output follows it. Missing evidence must be flagged or cause abstention.
theory.example: Five source / output / verdict rows; an intentionally missing source produces no fabricated claim.

theory.title: Save the test set
theory.text: Save fictional inputs, expected outputs and actual outputs in a versioned file. Add its link or content to My project.
theory.example: Another person can rerun the cases without asking you for private information.

errors.means: The result cannot yet be checked.
errors.fix: Run the case and save the observation; leave it pending if blocked.

canDo: Help draft test cases and explain observed errors
cantDo: Certify tests that nobody ran or approve on behalf of another person
